org.name: PetBhar
org.mission: PetBhar Initiative is a grassroots effort to ensure no one in our community goes to bed hungry. We work towards food security by providing meals and groceries to those who need it most.
org.description: We provide meals and essential groceries to families and individuals in need, because everyone deserves a full stomach and a better tomorrow.
org.philosophy: Starting small. Helping where we can. Growing with our community.

projects.title: Meal Drive — 50 Families
projects.description: Fresh meals provided to families in need.

projects.description: Feeding, water and basic care for stray animals in our community.
